formations_dates_order.name: formations_dates_order
formations_dates_order.value: "formations"."end_date" is null or "formations"."start_date" is null or "formations"."end_date" >= "formations"."start_date"

modules_planned_dates_check.name: modules_planned_dates_check
modules_planned_dates_check.value: "modules"."planned_end" is null or "modules"."planned_start" is null or "modules"."planned_end" >= "modules"."planned_start"

resources_note_shape.name: resources_note_shape
resources_note_shape.value: "resources"."kind" <> 'note' or "resources"."deleted_at" is not null or ("resources"."content_text" is not null and char_length("resources"."content_text") <= 100000 and "resources"."storage_path" is null and "resources"."url" is null)

resources_file_shape.name: resources_file_shape
resources_file_shape.value: "resources"."kind" not in ('pdf', 'image', 'audio', 'video') or "resources"."storage_path" is not null

resources_link_shape.name: resources_link_shape
resources_link_shape.value: "resources"."kind" not in ('web', 'youtube') or "resources"."url" is not null

resources_exam_guide_shape.name: resources_exam_guide_shape
resources_exam_guide_shape.value: "resources"."kind" <> 'exam_guide' or "resources"."storage_path" is not null or "resources"."url" is not null

resources_suggestion_shape.name: resources_suggestion_shape
resources_suggestion_shape.value: ("resources"."origin" = 'tutor_suggestion') = ("resources"."suggestion_status" is not null) and ("resources"."origin" = 'learner' or "resources"."url" is not null)

answers_score_max_score_check.name: answers_score_max_score_check
answers_score_max_score_check.value: "answers"."score" is null or "answers"."max_score" is null or "answers"."score" <= "answers"."max_score"

notion_states_gap_detected_at_check.name: notion_states_gap_detected_at_check
notion_states_gap_detected_at_check.value: "notion_states"."gap_nature" is null or "notion_states"."gap_detected_at" is not null

notion_states_gap_cleared_at_check.name: notion_states_gap_cleared_at_check
notion_states_gap_cleared_at_check.value: "notion_states"."gap_cleared_at" is null or "notion_states"."gap_detected_at" is null or "notion_states"."gap_cleared_at" >= "notion_states"."gap_detected_at"

notion_states_fsrs_check.name: notion_states_fsrs_check
notion_states_fsrs_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs") = 'object'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'due'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'stability'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'difficulty'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'elapsed_days'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'scheduled_days'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'reps'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'lapses'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'state'
        and "notion_states"."fsrs" ? 'last_review'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'due') = 'string'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'stability') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'difficulty') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'elapsed_days') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'scheduled_days') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'reps') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'lapses') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'state') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("notion_states"."fsrs" -> 'last_review') in ('string', 'null')

daily_activity_sources_check.name: daily_activity_sources_check
daily_activity_sources_check.value: array_position("daily_activity"."sources", null) is null and array_position("daily_activity"."sources", '') is null

notification_deliveries_scheduled_for_ch.name: notification_deliveries_scheduled_for_check
notification_deliveries_scheduled_for_ch.value: "notification_deliveries"."status" not in ('scheduled', 'deferred_quiet') or "notification_deliveries"."scheduled_for" is not null

notifications_href_check.name: notifications_href_check
notifications_href_check.value: "notifications"."href" like '/%' and "notifications"."href" not like '//%' and strpos("notifications"."href", chr(92)) = 0 and "notifications"."href" !~ '[\r\n\t ]' and char_length("notifications"."href") between 1 and 2048

ai_calls_error_code_check.name: ai_calls_error_code_check
ai_calls_error_code_check.value: "ai_calls"."error_code" is null or char_length("ai_calls"."error_code") between 1 and 80

ai_credentials_base_url_check.name: ai_credentials_base_url_check
ai_credentials_base_url_check.value: "ai_credentials"."base_url" is null or char_length("ai_credentials"."base_url") between 1 and 2048

ai_credentials_key_last4_check.name: ai_credentials_key_last4_check
ai_credentials_key_last4_check.value: ("ai_credentials"."encrypted_key" is null and "ai_credentials"."key_last4" is null) or ("ai_credentials"."encrypted_key" is not null and char_length("ai_credentials"."key_last4") = 4)
